lock: opening first frame must match @HeroStill exactly (hands holding 12CUT at sunlit window)
constraints: opening first frame must be @HeroStill exactly (live hero section image), then push-in into viewfinder
viewfinder window 4:3 LANDSCAPE rounded-rectangle only, NO square NO circle
product body matte white only, rounded-square
shutter button red dome top-right corner
heart strap tab red with white heart cutout, left side
lens hole circular center-right of FRONT face
'12cut' text embossed bottom-center of FRONT face
slides rotate LEFT, mechanical stepped NOT smooth
endcard product FRONT face centered ZERO motion
LEFT INDEX FINGER presses shutter, NEVER right hand
avoid identity drift, palette shift, jitter, background instability
exit: freeze on endcard with product + logo, ZERO motion, hold to 15s
